firewall: R4: FULL_DESCRIPTIVE output of the DECOMPOSITION strand - must not be read by the DISCOVERY strand.

population.survivorshipGap: Provider universe of today plus ended series; coverage of SEC 10-K filers 2000 14 %, 2010 22 %, 2020 48 % (protocol). Survivorship of issuers that vanished before universe formation is NOT measurable here; only the in-sample ended listings (V10 bounds) and the cap-weighted vs equal-weighted comparison are quantified.

returnBasis.spy: PRICE_RETURN (SPY split-adjusted close, same dates, no dividends)
returnBasis.totalReturn: only as labelled ESTIMATE in benchmark-reference-check.json

weighting: events: equal per event; funded: see A3
investmentAssumption: events: fully invested per event; funded strategy: slots of 1/N, unfilled slots in cash at 0 %; SPY: fully invested buy-and-hold
observedVsSecured: every cell reports the observed estimate and, separately, whether it is statistically secured (block bootstrap, Holm within the stated family)
shareDefinition: share = |contribution| / sum of |additive contributions| (benchmark, selection, costs, dividend estimate); entry, exit/holding, weighting, data coverage and uncertainty are non-additive diagnostics in Pp

selection.meaning: signal minus equal-weighted population of the same week (Auswahlqualitaet)

benchmark.meaning: equal-weighted survivor population minus SPY (Gleichgewichtung, Groesse, Zusammensetzung/Survivor)

dividends.state: ESTIMATE 2010+ (signal titles vs SPY distributions), sign = correction of the SPY excess if both sides were total return

dataCoverage.survivorCoverage: 10-K filer coverage 2000 14 %, 2010 22 %, 2020 48 %: not quantifiable as Pp; acts through the population term

rows.explanation: MOMENTUM_IMPROVED 13 W: beobachteter SPY-Ueberschuss (Kursrendite, netto) 0.48 Pp, nicht abgesichert (Holm-p 1).
